name: 四欄等寬：品牌欄＋連結群組＋底部列
desc: 內容分成數欄等寬並排，第一欄是標誌與小型徽章，其餘欄是小標題加文字連結或說明文字；最下方的底部列左側是小圖示連結、中間是一行小字，沒有分隔線。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的頁尾，放在頁面最下方，跟著頁面捲動。內容分成數欄等寬並排的連結群組，對齊頁面內容寬度，各欄靠上對齊：第一欄是品牌區，放標誌，標誌下方隔一段空白可放一個小型圖片徽章，沒有時省略；其餘各欄是數欄連結群組，每組是一個小標題加上直向排列的文字連結，小標題明顯大於下方文字。連結群組前可放一欄小標題加上多行次要資訊文字（數段說明文字），沒有時省略，其他欄位置不變。欄位與最下方的底部列之間留較大空白，兩者之間沒有分隔線；底部列左側是一排小圖示連結，與第一欄左緣對齊，一行小字放在底部列中間偏右的位置、文字置中。
mobile: 所有欄改為單欄由上往下堆疊：品牌區在最上方，標誌與小型圖片徽章水平置中、上下排列；其下依序是次要資訊文字那一欄和各組連結群組，連結群組改為直向堆疊，全部展開，靠左對齊。底部列改成上下兩行並置中：一排小圖示連結在上，一行小字在下。沒有動態效果。

en.name: Four equal columns: brand column + link groups + bottom bar
en.desc: A footer split into equal-width columns side by side: the first holds the logo and a small badge, the rest hold a group heading with text links or description text; the bottom bar has small icon links on the left and a line of small text in the middle, with no divider.
en.prompt: Create a footer whose height is determined by its content, placed at the very end of the page and scrolling with it. The content is split into link groups in several equal-width columns side by side, aligned to the page content width, with all columns top-aligned: the first column is the brand block holding the logo; optionally place a small image badge below the logo after a gap, and omit it when there is no content. The remaining columns are link groups, each a group heading followed by vertically stacked text links, with the group heading clearly larger than the text below it. Optionally place one column before the link groups holding a group heading and multiple lines of secondary text (several paragraphs of description); omit it when there is no content, without changing the position of the other columns. Leave a larger gap between the columns and the bottom bar at the very bottom, with no divider between them; the bottom bar has a row of small icon links on the left, aligned with the left edge of the first column, and a line of small text placed slightly right of the middle of the bottom bar, with its text centered.
en.mobile: All columns become a single column stacked top to bottom: the brand block is at the top, with the logo and the small image badge horizontally centered and stacked vertically; below it come the secondary-text column and then the link groups, which become a vertical stack, all expanded and left-aligned. The bottom bar becomes two lines, centered: the row of small icon links on top and the line of small text below. There is no motion.
